groups.anti_bias: Composite of methodology and source-corpus: empirical SDK/runtime tracing with comparative primary-source API checks, formal ontology/projection modeling, and adversarial privacy and authority analysis.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs empirical SDK and runtime tracing while agent 1 runs formal ontology and projection modeling on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 0 toward fitting the current manifest shape would be exposed by agent 1 when provenance, projection identity, or claim ceilings disappear, while a bias in agent 1 toward a complete semantic model would be exposed by agent 0 when no existing registry, validator, bridge route, or add-on lifecycle can carry it.

Agent 0 traces executable Add-on SDK and host seams while agent 2 performs adversarial privacy, grant, and authority analysis on the methodology axis; a bias in agent 0 toward an easy additive field would be exposed by agent 2 if it leaks private sources or widens route authority, while a bias in agent 2 toward maximal restriction would be exposed by agent 0 if existing closed contracts and grants already provide a safe narrow path.

Agent 1 models source-bound ontology projections while agent 2 attacks privacy and authority escalation on the methodology axis; a bias in agent 1 toward rich semantic exposure would be exposed by agent 2 through leakage, instruction-injection, stale-source, or write-path counterexamples, while a bias in agent 2 toward opaque minimalism would be exposed by agent 1 if provenance and structured conflict semantics become unusable.
